title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 203 East 6th Street in Lexington, Nebraska, as the ‘William E. and Elsie L. Barrett Post Office Building.
official_summary: This act designates the facility of the U.S. Postal Service located at 203 East 6th Street in Lexington, Nebraska, as the William E. and Elsie L. Barrett Post Office Building.

summary.headline: A federal law renames the Lexington, Nebraska Post Office building after William E. and Elsie L. Barrett.
summary.what_it_does: This act gives an official name to the U.S. Postal Service building at 203 East 6th Street in Lexington, Nebraska. The building will be called the William E. and Elsie L. Barrett Post Office Building. It does not change postal services, rules, or staffing.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 4, 2025.
